newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy steady to firmer.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean offers were mostly steady to one cent a bushel firmer, grain dealers said. Wheat values were unchanged.
The forecast of colder weather in parts of the U.S. will hamper movement, one U.S. exporter said.
A second cold surge behind the current Arctic front from Canada is expected to prolong into next week cold Midwest and Northeast temperatures, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
In export news, the Commodity Credit Corp bought 30,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for donation to Bosnia.
